about: Change log, like git log: one entry per set of changes, newest first. Only what changed, which files, and why. Plans, research and requirements live in PRD.md.

entries.summary: Prepare v0.1.1 with prebuilt-binary installs first
entries.why: Compiling from source still takes minutes on a fresh machine, which puts people off. README now leads with the curl script (prebuilt binary, under a second locally) and a Windows download, then `cargo binstall diskdiet` (binstall metadata added, matching the release asset names) before `cargo install`. Version bumped to 0.1.1 with a CHANGELOG entry, which the release workflow needs. Committed and pushed with the v0.1.1 tag to start the release workflow.

entries.summary: Make cargo install faster: thin LTO and only the ratatui features used
entries.why: `cargo install diskdiet` felt slow; half of a clean build (55 s of 106 s) was the final single-threaded fat-LTO link. The release profile now uses thin LTO and default codegen units, and ratatui drops its default macros and calendar widget, which diskdiet doesn't use. Clean install: 106 s to 62 s on the author's Intel Mac, binary 1.36 to 1.64 MB. A new `dist` profile keeps fat LTO for GitHub release binaries (still 1.36 MB), and release.yml builds with it.

entries.summary: Fix Windows path separators in the scan test
entries.why: CI failed on windows-latest: scan::tests::finds_artifacts_but_not_lookalikes compared paths with '/' but Windows prints '\\'. Test-only change; the scanner was fine.

entries.summary: Publish diskdiet v0.1.0 to crates.io and install from it
entries.why: User asked to publish. README's main install is now `cargo install diskdiet --locked` (the --git command stays as an alternative). install.sh's no-release fallback builds from crates.io (48 KB download) instead of cloning the GitHub repo, whose history carries ~340 MB of old build files. Published with --allow-dirty because these edits weren't committed yet.

entries.summary: Move .git and .github into DiskDiet/ so diskdiet is at the repo root
entries.why: The git repo (.git and .github) had been left in the parent workspace folder (/Users/user/audah), causing GitHub to show DiskDiet/ and mannerly/ as subfolders with no root README. Moved .git and .github into DiskDiet/ so the crate and README.md sit at the root of Baimmmss/diskdiet, and updated README, install.sh, and workflow paths back to the repo root.

entries.summary: Fix install and CI for the DiskDiet/ subfolder layout

deleted: target/ (12,342 build files, untracked from git only; still on disk)

entries.why: Pushed commit 6703ca8 moved the crate into DiskDiet/ next to mannerly/ and committed ~1.2 GB of build files. README `cargo install --git` now names the package (`diskdiet`), since mannerly/Cargo.toml made the plain command fail; links point at master/DiskDiet/. target/ is ignored and untracked. Workflows run in DiskDiet/ (working-directory, rust-cache workspaces, manifest-path, changelog path) and CI triggers on master instead of main.

entries.summary: Make every README install method work before the first release
entries.why: diskdiet is not on crates.io and the GitHub repo has no releases, so `cargo install diskdiet` and the install script failed; the raw URLs also pointed at a `main` branch that doesn't exist (it's `master`). README now uses `cargo install --git`, a clone + `cargo install --path` option and `master` URLs. install.sh falls back to building from source with cargo when no release binary exists, and still verifies checksums when one does.

entries.summary: Start PRD.md and log.json for diskdiet
entries.why: AGENTS.md requires both files in every project folder. State at this point: v0.1.0 Rust CLI/TUI, public at github.com/Baimmmss/diskdiet (master), no GitHub release, not on crates.io. Added both to Cargo.toml `exclude` so they stay out of a future crates.io package.
